cases.name: Mary Evelyn McKee
cases.narrative: On 2/21/1995, her body was found in a gully between two homes. On 2/20/1995, Mary left her house for a walk and never returned. He attacked her while she was taking a walk, dragged her to a low-lying ditch with the intent to rape her and beat her to death with two large rocks. He had a fractured jaw and her bits of her teeth were scattered around her. She had died from repeated blows to her face and head. Her pantyhose and panties had been removed, her longish skirt was hiked up to her mid-thigh, and her blouse was ripped partially open.

cases.name: Deanie Payne Logan
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a member of First Presbyterian Church.  She was a teacher graduating from Eastern Kentucky University.  She was most proud of being a homemaker, mother and grandmother."
cases.narrative: On 11/22/2020, a family member found her on the sidewalk in front of her home. He had shot her twice in the head.
